card.name: Start of a plural-noun after a number word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer noun (ep-, cast-, sy-, wet-, cav-, vent-) right after a number or quantity word like four, two, both, third. The noun is a countable thing that is about to be named, often in plural.

modes.label: Number then noun start
modes.description: Noun begins right after a count word such as four, two or third.
modes.example: is one of the four<< ep>>istles written during his first imprisonment at Rome
